failure_semantics.admitted: Every ordered in-memory transaction, serialization, prepublication reconstruction, descriptor-rooted publication, sync, read-back, final identity, and semantic reconstruction predicate passed before the opaque receipt was minted.
failure_semantics.published_unverified: The exclusive rename reported success, but directory sync, final descriptor join, exact read-back, reconstruction, close, final inventory, or named-parent rebound did not complete exactly. The final is retained as evidence and no retry or reinterpretation is permitted.
failure_semantics.prepublication_state_unknown: No exclusive rename was entered, but exact inspection cannot prove both that staging creation was never entered and that the final leaf is absent. Observed entries are evidence-only; both leases enter terminal inspection state and no retry or reinterpretation is permitted.
failure_semantics.publication_outcome_unknown: Exclusive rename was entered without exact reported success or the post-entry namespace could not be classified exactly. Every observed entry is retained as evidence and no retry or reinterpretation is permitted.
failure_semantics.rejected_before_publication: No staging creation was entered, the final leaf is proven absent, and the in-memory transaction or prepublication image validation rejected. Both leases poison and no retry is permitted.
failure_semantics.staging_retained: Staging creation returned success and the held staging inode remains joined, but exact write, seal, full sync, read-back, lifetime, or prepublication continuity failed before rename entry. Staging is retained and both leases enter terminal inspection state.
failure_semantics.transaction_outcome_unknown: The private in-memory COMMIT was entered without exact reported success. No filesystem publication is entered; both leases become terminal and no retry is permitted.
failure_semantics.unavailable: A competing call observes IN_PROGRESS; a later call observes ALREADY_CONSUMED, COMMIT_REQUIRES_INSPECTION, EXPIRED, or POISONED according to retained process-local state.

fixed_filesystem_contract.directory: canonical 0700 effective-uid-owned empty root, exclusively flocked and descriptor-held throughout

implementation_hard_stops: No SQLite connection may receive a filesystem path, URI, caller-selected VFS, /dev/fd path, cwd mutation, or caller-selected path, filename, SQL, descriptor, flag, or fault in production.

No rollback journal, WAL, SHM, temp leaf, custom VFS, sqlite3_backup-to-path, replacement rename, cleanup, unlink, repair, adoption, retry, process, VM, guest, network, signal, app entry, Git, or GitHub action is authorized.
No physical publication may be called an atomic database COMMIT, and F_FULLFSYNC may not be treated as mathematical power-loss proof.
No fixture result may enter or complete H4, authorize H5, promote Gate E, evaluate a candidate, mint authority, or create a production H3/store capability.
ordered_success_predicates: admit and hold the exact empty private root
open only a private SQLITE_OPEN_MEMORY writer and install the frozen limits and hardening
create and validate the existing STRICT singleton schema and exact canonical row inside one transaction
recheck both owner and store-grant lifetimes immediately before COMMIT
enter COMMIT once and require exact SQLITE_OK
serialize main through one fixed-arity bridge and require positive 4096-byte-aligned size at most 262144 bytes
close the writer exactly

copy-deserialize the serialized image into a fresh private read-only connection and validate header, integrity, schema, row, canonical CBOR, indexed fields, JSON round trip, CBOR round trip, and semantic join
close the prepublication reader exactly and recheck both lifetimes before staging creation
create and hold the exact fresh staging inode and require inventory containing only staging
ftruncate to the exact image size and enter one bounded pwrite that returns the full image size
fchmod staging to 0400, require exact regular-file identity, owner, mode, nlink, and size, then fsync and F_FULLFSYNC
pread exact bytes plus EOF from the held staging descriptor and require byte equality to the serialized image
recheck both lifetimes immediately before visibility publication
enter one descriptor-rooted renameatx_np with the frozen exclusive flags and no fallback
require inventory containing only final and join final fstatat identity to the still-held staging descriptor
fsync the held parent directory
open final once with descriptor-rooted O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, join its vnode to the write descriptor, and read exact bytes plus EOF
deserialize only the held final read-back bytes into a fresh private read-only connection and revalidate integrity, schema, row, canonical streams, and semantic join
close the reader, final descriptor, and staging descriptor exactly, rejoin final identity and inventory, and rejoin the named parent to the held root
mint the opaque success receipt last
out_of_scope_later_freezes: bounded crash cutpoints and orphan-state classification
real constrained-volume ENOSPC, EIO, disk-full, and partial physical-write evidence
restart anti-replay, rollback resistance, authenticity, and external hash or Merkle commitment
APFS snapshots, clones, backups, secure deletion, and encryption at rest
production H3 handoff, privacy-minimized H3 receipt/root commitment, and production store grant

retention_scope.operation: The one-shot store operation never cleans, unlinks, repairs, adopts, retries, or reinterprets staging, final, or unexpected evidence.
retention_scope.test_fixture: EPR_H4_PRIVACY_TESTS may remove a private throwaway root only in XCTest teardown after all outcome and retention assertions complete; teardown is not part of the one-shot operation and creates no product behavior or evidence claim.

residuals: Darwin directory locks are advisory. Same-euid, root, or Full-Disk-Access code can mutate a reachable vnode; descriptor and byte joins prevent that mutation from producing a false receipt but do not create hostile same-user isolation.

renameatx_np with RENAME_EXCL prevents replacement of an existing final leaf but has no atomic compare-and-rename-this-exact-inode operation; retained-descriptor post-joins detect failure rather than preventing every transient namespace mutation.
F_FULLFSYNC is the strongest exposed Darwin flush request, not proof against every device, firmware, power-loss, or filesystem failure.
A crash after staging creation or final publication but before receipt leaves an unadopted orphan and can never become PASS in this slice.
test_contract: success proves the exact root transition empty to staging to final and no journal, WAL, SHM, temp, or unknown entry
serialization failure, oversize, misalignment, invalid header, and failed prepublication reconstruction reject before staging
staging collision and unknown initial entry reject before publication
deterministic truncate, pwrite error, zero, short, overrun, mode, stat, fsync, fullsync, read-back, and lifetime faults retain staging and never publish
deterministic rename collision, reported error, and ambiguous post-entry inspection map to publication-outcome-unknown or an exact pre-entry rejection without retry
directory-sync, final-open, final-vnode, final-byte, deserialize, schema, row, semantic, close, inventory, and parent-rebound faults become published-unverified
sequential and concurrent calls have one winner; replay, expiry, owner join, and separate store-grant lifetime remain exact
fault injection is deterministic userspace evidence and is not labeled actual ENOSPC, EIO, crash, power-loss, or partial physical-write evidence
test seams and symbols are absent from Debug and Release application binaries
verification_order: commit this control-only freeze on the exact predecessor
commit only the exact implementation allowlist with this freeze as parent
run focused tests, full Debug and Release tests, Debug and Release app builds, static surface scans, and three independent reviews after the implementation commit
commit a result-only checkpoint and detached SHA-256 sidecar only after verification
